Definition: Jeish, the name of an Edomite and of a an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Jeish is the name as it is written in Genesis, the ketiv spelling of the son Esau's wife Aholibamah bare him. The same verses read the name Jeush, and the two spellings stand side by side in the text, the written form and the form that is read. He is the son of Esau in the land of Canaan, with Jaalam and Korah his brothers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the written word and the spoken word are both God's, and the two spellings of one man's name are kept on purpose. My position is that Jeish and Jeush are one man, and the text refuses to let either spelling go.
